name: Yuuki Hikaru
source: A second-year student at St. Eijo Academy, she is a quiet girl with a somewhat cool demeanor, not timid or nervous. Possesses a fair sense of justice and accepts George's request. Although they haven't known each other for long, she doesn't dislike George and feels that something fun might be about to start. Has a slender, developing figure. While George is on the run, he entrusts her with Octova, transforming her into a magical girl to fight against Nemesis monsters.
